## Batch correction

If batch effects are present, I can perform batch correction with the `fastMNN`(Mutual nearest neighbors) from the [batchelor](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/batchelor.html) package. 

**BE AWARE**: In general, *cell-based* analyses are safe to apply on corrected data; indeed, the whole purpose of the correction is to place all cells in the same coordinate space. However, the same cannot be easily said for *gene-based* procedures like DE analyses or marker gene detection. See [here](https://bioconductor.org/books/3.14/OSCA.multisample/using-corrected-values.html#for-between-batch-comparisons) for more information.

```{r batch-corr, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#TO BE UPDATED

library(batchelor)

# Load data
sce_1 <- readRDS("~/switchdrive/RCC_project/data/rcc_sce_Batch20200528.rds")
sce_2 <- readRDS("~/switchdrive/RCC_project/data/rcc_sce_Batch20201113.rds")
sce_3 <- readRDS("~/switchdrive/RCC_project/data/rcc_sce_Batch20210304.rds")

# Combine different batches
## Synchronize rowdata
universe <- intersect(rownames(sce_1),rownames(sce_2))
sce_1 <- sce_1[universe,]
sce_2 <- sce_2[universe,]
rownames(sce_3)[which(rownames(sce_3) == "LAG3 / LAG33")] <- "LAG3"
sce_3 <- sce_3[universe,]

rowData(sce_1) -> rowData(sce_2) -> rowData(sce_3)

## Combine objects by columns (adding new columns to colData if unique in any sce object - ideally the same columns should be present)
sce <- combineCols(sce_1,sce_2,sce_3)
assay(sce,"exprs") <- as.matrix(assay(sce,"exprs"))

# Run MNN
set.seed(22)
mnn.out <- fastMNN(sce_1,sce_2,sce_3, d=NA, k=20, assay.type = "exprs",subset.row=rowData(sce_1)$use_channel,
    BSPARAM=BiocSingular::RandomParam(deferred=TRUE))

#the corrected matrix contains low-dimensional corrected coordinates for all cells, which we will use in "cell-based" downstream analyses.
dim(reducedDim(mnn.out, "corrected"))

reducedDim(sce,"corrected") <- reducedDim(mnn.out, "corrected")

set.seed(22)
sce <- runUMAP(sce, dimred="corrected",name = "UMAP_cor") 

#Compare before and after                        
plotReducedDim(sce, dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "BatchId")
plotReducedDim(sce, dimred = "UMAP_cor", colour_by = "BatchId")

###Save RDS object after MNN
saveRDS(sce, "/Volumes/rcc_volume/IMMUCAN/rcc_sce_BatchCombined_Corrected.rds")
```
